deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.body:
Deleting your account removes your information such as nickname and date of birth, and it can't be undone.

• If you have active subscriptions, cancel them in the App Store or Google Play first. Deleting your account does not stop store billing.
• You won't be able to see your chats again. Save any photos, voice or videos you want to keep beforehand.
• Replies you sent will be shown to stars as "Deleted fan".

subscribeFlow.refundNote: You can withdraw within 7 days of payment for a full refund. You can also request a refund if the artist sent no messages during the period or the artist stopped their activity.
subscribeFlow.messageNote: Artists send messages irregularly, depending on their schedule. Messages, photos, voice and videos are for subscribers only and must not be shared outside the app.
subscribeFlow.bundleNote: Artists in a bundle may change depending on the artist or agency.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.menuHint: Monthly sales, store fees and payouts, CSV download (PC web)
settlement.webOnly: Please check settlements on the PC web
settlement.webOnlyBody: Settlement tables are large and sensitive, so they aren't shown in the phone app. Sign in with the same account in a PC browser.
settlement.sandboxIncluded: Includes test (unpaid) subscriptions — not actual settlement amounts.
settlement.note: Estimates from payment records (month in Thailand time). The {{fee}}% store fee and default {{share}}% share are provisional and vary by agency contract. Bundles are split by list-price ratio; CP rooms 50/50 between the two artists. Reconcile with store payout reports for actual amounts (local prices, FX, taxes).
settlement.closeConfirm: Lock the {{month}} settlement with the current figures? Refunds or late payments after closing go to next month's adjustments, not this month. Pay out based on the closed table.
settlement.reopenConfirm: Reopen {{month}}? If you've already paid out, it's safer to leave it closed and handle changes as next month's adjustments. Reopening recalculates with current data.
settlement.closedAt: Closed — {{date}}, {{name}}. This table is frozen as of closing (later refunds or payments go to next month's adjustments).
settlement.openCurrent: Current month — figures keep changing. You can close it after the month ends.
settlement.openPast: Not closed yet — figures may change if refunds arrive. Close it before paying out.
settlement.unpaid: No payout recorded yet — amount due {{amount}}
settlement.payoutNegative: Nothing to pay ({{amount}}) — deducted from the next payout
settlement.payoutDeleteConfirm: Only delete a record that was entered by mistake. This removes the record only — it doesn't cancel the actual transfer (it stays in the admin activity log).
settlement.payoutAmountInvalid: Enter the amount sent as a number
